entities.name: Early Christian Church
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The institutional body of Christ founded at Pentecost (c. 30 CE), governed initially by the apostles in Jerusalem and expanding through Paul's missionary journeys. Developed episcopal governance, creeds, sacraments, and the NT canon over the first centuries.
